d:
The search for Bigfoot takes the team through another series of challenging investigations, where reported sightings, unexplained sounds and possible evidence offer fresh leads. With every discovery raising new questions, the team follows the trail deeper into Bigfoot territory, hoping to find something that finally backs up the claims. But will these leads bring them closer to conclusive evidence, or will the mystery remain unsolved?
Watch Expedition Bigfoot, Season 4, Episodes 6, 1, 5, 7, 2, 3 and 8, on Discovery Channel India.
